title: Yashwantrao Holkar
subtitle: The Holkar who fought the British alone · 1776 – 1811
subject: yashwantrao-holkar
intro: Yashwantrao Holkar seized the Holkar state in a succession war, defeated the Peshwa and the Shindes at Pune in 1802, and then fought the East India Company largely on his own in 1804–05 — beating a British column, besieging Delhi, and holding out at Bharatpur before making peace on comparatively good terms. He died at 34, his plans for a new war unrealised.

events.title: Escape from Nagpur
events.summary: After his father's death Yashwantrao takes refuge with the Bhonsles of Nagpur, is held there, and escapes to raise his own army.

events.title: A base at Bhanpura
events.summary: Yashwantrao makes Bhanpura his headquarters, casting cannon there for a new war against the British.

events.title: Yashwantrao born
events.summary: Yashwantrao is born to Tukoji Holkar, the commander who led the Holkar army under Ahilyabai.

events.title: Tukoji dies; succession war
events.summary: After Tukoji's death his sons fight over the succession. Daulatrao Shinde backs Kashi Rao; Yashwantrao's brother Malharrao is killed in an attack by Shinde's troops near Pune, and Yashwantrao flees.

events.title: Yashwantrao takes control
events.summary: Gathering an army of Holkar loyalists, Pindaris and others, Yashwantrao wins over most of the Holkar forces. He rules in the name of his young nephew Khanderao, Malharrao's son.

events.title: Battle of Ujjain
events.summary: Yashwantrao defeats a Shinde army and plunders Ujjain, the Shinde capital.

events.title: Brother Vithoji executed by the Peshwa
events.summary: Bajirao II has Yashwantrao's brother Vithoji trampled to death by an elephant in Pune. Yashwantrao vows revenge.

events.title: Indore sacked
events.summary: The Shinde general Sarje Rao Ghatge defeats Yashwantrao near Indore and sacks the city.

events.title: Battle of Poona
events.summary: Yashwantrao defeats the combined armies of the Peshwa and the Shindes at Hadapsar outside Pune. Bajirao II flees to the coast.

events.title: Amrut Rao set up as Peshwa
events.summary: Holding Pune, Yashwantrao installs Bajirao's adoptive brother Amrut Rao as Peshwa — a regime that lasts only until the British restore Bajirao.

events.title: Treaty of Bassein
events.summary: The fugitive Bajirao signs a subsidiary alliance with the British, who restore him in Pune in May 1803.

events.title: Stays out of the Second Anglo-Maratha War
events.summary: When Shinde and the Bhonsle of Nagpur fight the British in 1803, Yashwantrao stays aloof — a decision that lets the British defeat the Maratha houses one at a time.

events.title: War with the Company
events.summary: After failed negotiations, Governor-General Wellesley's government declares war on Holkar.

events.title: Monson's retreat
events.summary: Yashwantrao's cavalry harries a British column under Colonel Monson through the monsoon from the Mukundra pass back to Agra, destroying much of it — one of the worst British setbacks in India.

events.title: Siege of Delhi
events.summary: Holkar's army besieges Delhi, defended by David Ochterlony, but withdraws as Lake's army approaches.

events.title: Deeg and Farrukhabad
events.summary: Holkar's infantry is defeated at Deeg, and Lake surprises his cavalry at Farrukhabad four days later.

events.title: Siege of Bharatpur
events.summary: Yashwantrao shelters with the Jat ruler of Bharatpur. Lake's four assaults on the fortress fail with heavy losses before Bharatpur makes terms.

events.title: Treaty of Rajghat
events.summary: With the Company tired of war after Wellesley's recall, Yashwantrao makes peace and recovers most of his territory.

events.title: Rules in his own name
events.summary: After his nephew Khanderao's death, Yashwantrao rules the Holkar state in his own right.

events.title: Preparing for another war
events.summary: At Bhanpura he builds a cannon foundry and drills a new army, intending to renew the war — but his health and mind begin to fail.

events.title: Dies at Bhanpura
events.summary: Yashwantrao dies at Bhanpura, aged 34. Within six years the Holkar army is defeated at Mahidpur and Indore becomes a British-protected state.
